# Fixture sources

`json-patch-tests.json` is an unmodified snapshot of
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/json-patch/json-patch-tests/master/tests.json
retrieved 2026-09-30. Copyright 2014 The Authors. Apache License 2.0:
https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0 .

`correctness.json` contains 11 manual cases, 62 valid document/expected pairs
derived from those Apache-2.0 tests, and 300 locally generated JSON pairs with
seed 20260930. See the original evaluation's data/manifest.json for provenance.
Local cases are covered by this project's MIT license; upstream-derived cases
